title: Reversal Signal
tagline: Built for falling and sideways markets. Buys oversold bounces, exits at the mean.
rules: Setup: RSI(14) below 30 and close below the lower Bollinger Band (20, 2)
Trigger: bullish candle (close > open) closing in the top half of its range (rejection)
Filter: 20-day avg turnover above Rs 10 lakh
Stop: 1.5 × ATR(14) below entry (tighter — mean reversion). Trail: none; exit at the mean
Targets: T1 = 20-day SMA (the mean), T2 = entry + 2 × risk (reference levels — not traded; see methodology)

provenance.recent_source: own NEPSE direct via live.json overlay
provenance.note: Historical bars from scraper; most recent sessions from our own NEPSE feed. asof reflects actual last bar, not build time.

stats.sharpe_note: Annualised from weekly portfolio returns (marked to market).
stats.equity_note: Weekly portfolio value: cash + open positions at last close, minus estimated exit costs.

data_quality.position_sizing: Fixed Rs 10,00,000 notional per position; not compounded with portfolio growth.
data_quality.costs: 0.5% round-trip (broker + SEBON + DP, simplified): half charged at entry, half at exit.

alerts.rule: RSI(14)<30 + below lower Bollinger Band + bullish rejection
alerts.targets_note: Reference levels for position management — not traded in the backtest.

portfolio.sizing_note: Fixed notional — position size does not grow with the portfolio.

disclaimer: Educational backtest on historical data. Not investment advice. Past performance does not predict future results.

live_track_record.method: Seeded from the engine's verifiable alert history: every distinct BUY alert found in git-committed signal JSONs on origin/main (2026-09-30 commits onward), each traced to its real alert record (system, symbol, signal date, published entry/stop/targets). Exits on real forward OHLC from the owned archive: target 1, stop loss, a trailing stop ratcheted from the stop (never from future-informed levels), or a 20-session time exit. Same-bar precedence is conservative: stop, then trail, then target. P&L net of 0.5% round-trip charges. Ongoing alerts are captured daily by the same logic; nothing here comes from the 2003-2026 backtest replay.

live_track_record.note: Forward-tested paper trades from this system's live alerts. Entries at the signal close; exits on real forward OHLC (target 1 / stop loss / trailing stop / 20-session time exit). P&L is net of 0.5% round-trip charges. Updated daily after close.
